name: SvelteKit
description: SvelteKit is the application framework for Svelte; with adapter-static and mdsvex it prerenders Markdown posts to static HTML.
notes: Application framework used as an SSG through adapter-static and mdsvex (Markdown compiled to Svelte components). firstRelease from the first public SvelteKit beta (2020). Minimal site: bare layout, one post route and one index route.
